name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness — an Electron wrapper around the dsh web server

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/preload.js',{force:true});require('fs').rmSync('dist/preload.js.map',{force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('dist/preload.js','dist/preload.cjs')"
scripts.test:recovery: npm run build && node scripts/recovery-ring-buffer.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-parse-failure.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-state.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-ipc-guard.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-theme.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-versions.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-patch.test.mjs && node scripts/recovery-plugins.test.mjs
